summary: REGRESSION SWEEP after Expo SDK 54 -> 57 upgrade + @expo/vector-icons -> @react-native-vector-icons/ionicons v13 migration + use-tab-scroll-to-top hook import switch to expo-router. Result: NO REGRESSIONS FOUND. (1) App boots at /landing with zero page errors, zero console errors, no red-screen; landing renders alarm/scan/trending-down Ionicons cleanly. (2) Login with e2e_test_1786703401@example.com / Password123! via [data-testid=signin-email-input]/[data-testid=signin-password-input] navigates to /dashboard in ~4s. (3) All 5 bottom tabs navigate correctly: /dashboard, /sites, /reports, /support, /profile (verified via role=tab a[href] elements). (4) Icons render on every tested screen: dashboard (bell/fire-outline/lightning/store-outline + tab icons), sites list, site detail (broadband globe, telecoms phone, meter receipt), reports (bar-chart plus £ hero), quote wizard (⚡🔥💧📞 in Ionicons), support, profile — no tofu / no missing glyph placeholders. Font loader (@react-native-vector-icons/ionicons 13.1.4 dynamic loader) works. (5) Profile -> Demo data toggle ([data-testid=profile-demo-toggle]) flips cleanly and populates 5 demo sites (site-card-p1..p5), 10 contracts, 5 urgent renewals (renewals-header + renewal-biz-0/renewal-site-p1/renewal-contract-e1/g1 etc), and reports (£49,930 spend across 10 contracts, by-utility bars for Electricity/Gas/Water/Telecoms/Broadband, by-site bars for Manchester Warehouse/Head Office/Riverside Cafe Bath+Oxford). (6) Site detail (/sites/p3?name=Bristol Retail Unit): site-detail-header shows 'Bristol Retail Unit', Broadband + Telecoms utility cards render, Rates & estimated cost card visible, Meter details block (BT-0098-221, SB1C88, 6 Dec 2024, 6 Dec 2026) renders, Get Quote + Request Callback buttons render; site-detail-back button returns to /sites. (7) Quote wizard /quote/new renders 'Get a Quote — Step 1 of 3' with wizard testIDs [quote-header, quote-step-pip-0/1/2, step-service, wizard-next], four service tiles (Electric/Gas/Water/Telecoms) and Continue CTA. (8) Reanimated 4.5.1 + react-native-worklets 0.10.1: NO worklet crashes, NO 'Reanimated' console errors observed across full sweep. CtaShimmer testIDs [lower-bills-cta, lower-bills-cta-pill] mount cleanly on demo dashboard. (9) Bottom-sheet modals not clipped: 'Have a query? Chat with our team' pill opens concierge-sheet 'Message us directly' at the bottom, sheet is fully visible with input + Cancel/Send buttons; Meter Installation quick-action opens the same concierge-sheet cleanly; business chips (sites-business-chip, reports-business-chip) + profile-add-business testIDs present and clickable. (10) Tab scroll-to-top: [data-testid=dashboard-scroll] is present on the dashboard ScrollView; useTabScrollToTop hook now imports useScrollToTop from expo-router (verified in src/utils/use-tab-scroll-to-top.ts:3) and no bundling error occurs. Console warnings (non-blocking, pre-existing RNW deprecation notices): 'shadow*' style props deprecated and 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated — these come from RN Web core / third-party libs and are unrelated to this upgrade. Installed versions verified to match package.json: expo 57.0.21, react-native 0.86.3, reanimated 4.5.1, worklets 0.10.1, ionicons 13.1.4. Old expo@54.x doctor warnings in /var/log/supervisor/expo.err.log are STALE historical lines from before this upgrade — the current bundle is clean SDK 57. No deprecated Expo packages detected. No SafeAreaView issues detected. This is a clean pass — the SDK 54 -> 57 infrastructure upgrade did NOT introduce any customer-facing regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: src/utils/use-tab-scroll-to-top.ts:3 correctly imports useScrollToTop from 'expo-router' (previously '@react-navigation/native'). Expo Router re-exports the same hook, so behaviour is preserved. Verified: no bundling failure, useFocusEffect from expo-router still works. Good.

package.json is fully aligned with Expo SDK 57 baseline (expo 57.0.21, react-native 0.86.3, react 19.2.3, reanimated 4.5.1, worklets 0.10.1). All installed versions in node_modules match. No version drift.

@react-native-vector-icons/ionicons@13.1.4 loads Ionicons via a runtime font loader (unlike the old static require in @expo/vector-icons). This test confirmed the loader resolves fonts on Expo Web preview — icons paint on first render across all screens with no tofu characters. If the same migration is applied to native builds (iOS/Android), verify with a native build too since web is a lower bar for font loading.

Stale warning noise in /var/log/supervisor/expo.err.log about expo@54.0.36 vs 54.0.37 are from PRE-UPGRADE runs — supervisor keeps append-only logs. Consider rotating the log after major upgrades to prevent confusion in future debug sessions. Non-blocking.

Non-blocking RNW deprecation warnings ('shadow*' -> use boxShadow, props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents) will become errors in a future react-native-web release. Sweep the codebase for legacy shadow* / pointerEvents props in a future clean-up pass — but not urgent and not part of this SDK 57 upgrade regression.
seed_data_creation: None — demo data is generated by the in-app 'Demo mode' toggle (profile-demo-toggle) which mocks GET /properties, /businesses, /renewals/urgent, /reports/spend responses locally; live backend is untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: fill [data-testid=signin-email-input] with e2e_test_1786703401@example.com, [data-testid=signin-password-input] with Password123!, click text=Sign in. Auth persists via secureStore -> localStorage only within the same Playwright browser context; spawning a new mcp_browser_automation call wipes localStorage, so login + navigation must happen in one script. Tab navigation: tabs render as <a role='tab' href='/dashboard|/sites|/reports|/support|/profile'> — use page.locator('a[href*="/reports"]').first, NOT get_by_text (labels are inside separate spans). Demo toggle: click [data-testid=profile-demo-toggle] once from Profile screen, then dashboard/sites/reports repopulate. Site detail: 5 demo sites are site-card-p1..p5, tap opens /sites/{id}?name=&address=, header is [data-testid=site-detail-header], back is [data-testid=site-detail-back]. Bottom sheets: 'Have a query' pill and Meter Installation quick-action both open [data-testid=concierge-sheet]. Quote wizard: /quote/new, next button = [data-testid=wizard-next], service step = [data-testid=step-service]. No spotlight tour appeared for this account (already completed).
rca_of_issue: N/A — this iteration is a regression sweep after the SDK 54->57 upgrade. No bugs found.
